form_fields.name: monitor_url
form_fields.label: URL
form_fields.description: 监控的目标网址链接，以检测其可用性和性能。
form_fields.guide_short: 拨测目标地址（不含 query）；IPv6 需用方括号，如 https://[2001:db8::1]/。Query 请在「请求参数」中填写。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Probe target URL without a query string. Enclose IPv6 literals in brackets, as in https://[2001:db8::1]/, and enter query data under Query Parameters.

form_fields.name: interval
form_fields.label: 间隔
form_fields.description: 监控数据的采集时间间隔（单位：秒）
form_fields.guide_short: Telegraf inputs.http_response 采集周期，单位秒，默认 60；过短会高频访问目标站点，建议 ≥30。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Telegraf inputs.http_response probe interval in seconds; the default is 60. Short intervals create frequent target traffic; use at least 30 seconds when practical.

form_fields.name: insecure_skip_verify
form_fields.label: 跳过证书校验
form_fields.guide_short: 仅 HTTPS 自签或证书链不完整时开启；生产环境建议关闭，避免中间人风险被掩盖。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Enable only temporarily for HTTPS with a self-signed or incomplete certificate chain. Keep it disabled in production so certificate and man-in-the-middle risks are not hidden.

form_fields.name: request_method
form_fields.label: 请求方式
form_fields.description: 仅支持不会修改目标资源的 GET、HEAD 与 POST 拨测。
form_fields.guide_short: 仅支持 GET、HEAD、POST。POST 才允许填写请求体；HEAD 只取响应头，适合探活且流量更小。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Supports GET, HEAD, and POST only. The request body is available only for POST; HEAD retrieves headers only and uses less traffic for availability checks.

form_fields.name: request_body
form_fields.label: 请求体
form_fields.guide_short: 仅 POST 可用。填写原始文本（JSON/XML/表单等），并通过 Content-Type 请求头声明格式，例如 application/json。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Available only for POST. Enter the raw JSON, XML, or form body and declare its format with a Content-Type header such as application/json.

form_fields.name: request_params
form_fields.label: 请求参数
form_fields.guide_short: URL 本身不要带 query。参数按填写顺序 URL 编码后追加；同名参数可重复。空行会自动忽略。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Do not include a query string in the base URL. Parameters are URL-encoded and appended in entry order; duplicate names are allowed and blank rows are ignored.

form_fields.name: request_headers
form_fields.label: 请求头
form_fields.guide_short: 仅填非敏感头，如 Content-Type、Accept。不要手写 Authorization；Basic/Bearer 请用下方认证配置，凭据走环境变量下发。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Enter only non-sensitive headers such as Content-Type and Accept. Do not set Authorization manually; use the Basic or Bearer fields so credentials are injected through environment variables.

form_fields.name: auth_type
form_fields.label: 认证方式
form_fields.guide_short: 无认证 / Basic Auth / Bearer Token。凭据写入 env_config，不会进入 Telegraf 配置正文。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Select no authentication, Basic Auth, or Bearer Token. Credentials are stored in env_config rather than rendered into the Telegraf configuration body.

form_fields.name: username
form_fields.label: 用户名
form_fields.guide_short: Basic Auth 用户名；选择 Basic Auth 时必填。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Basic Auth username; enter it when Basic Auth is selected.

form_fields.name: ENV_PASSWORD
form_fields.label: 密码
form_fields.guide_short: Basic Auth 密码；含特殊字符无需转义。通过环境变量注入，不要写进请求头。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Basic Auth password. Special characters need no escaping; it is injected through an environment variable, so do not place it in a request header.

form_fields.name: ENV_BEARER_TOKEN
form_fields.label: Bearer Token
form_fields.guide_short: Bearer Token 明文值（无需再加 Bearer 前缀）；通过环境变量注入 Authorization 头。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Bearer token value only, without the Bearer prefix. It is injected through an environment variable into the Authorization header.

form_fields.name: response_status_code
form_fields.label: 期望状态码
form_fields.guide_short: 期望 HTTP 状态码（100–599）。留空则不校验状态码；不匹配时拨测结果为「响应状态码不匹配」。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Expected HTTP status code from 100 to 599. Leave it empty to disable status matching; a mismatch produces a response-status-code-mismatch probe result.

form_fields.name: response_string_match
form_fields.label: 期望响应内容
form_fields.guide_short: 对响应正文执行的正则表达式。留空则不校验内容；正则不匹配时拨测结果为「响应内容不匹配」。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Regular expression evaluated against the response body. Leave it empty to disable content matching; a non-match produces a response-content-mismatch probe result.

form_fields.name: response_timeout
form_fields.label: 请求超时
form_fields.guide_short: 单次拨测超时秒数（1–600）。留空默认 5 秒（Telegraf http_response 默认值）；超时记为「超时」失败。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Per-probe timeout from 1 to 600 seconds. An empty value uses the Telegraf http_response default of 5 seconds; a timeout is recorded as a probe failure.

form_fields.name: follow_redirects
form_fields.label: 跟随重定向
form_fields.guide_short: 是否跟随 3xx 重定向。关闭时以首跳响应判断状态码与内容；开启时对最终落地页做判断。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Controls 3xx redirects. When disabled, status and content are evaluated on the first response; when enabled, they are evaluated on the final destination.

rules.message: URL必须以http://或https://开头，IPv6地址需使用方括号
